title: Mumbai Indians Vs UP Warriorz Live Streaming, WPL 2026: When And Where To Watch MI-UPW Coverage On TV And Online | Cricket News - News18
text: Mumbai Indians take on the UP Warriorz in their next match of the Women’s Premier League 2026, scheduled for Thursday, January 15, in Navi Mumbai. The defending champions aim for their third consecutive triumph of the season after a defeat to the Royal Challengers Bengaluru in their opening game. Harmanpreet Kaur & co defeated the Gujarat Giants in their previous encounter by seven wickets. The skipper led from the front and played a magnificent innings of 71 not out in her team’s successful run chase of the 193-run target. Harmanpreet won MI the high-scoring clash to push them over the third-placed Giants in the WPL 2026 points table, behind only numero uno RCB. The Warriorz, on the other hand, have had a disastrous beginning to their campaign. Led by Aussie legend Meg Lanning, they’ve suffered three consecutive defeats. The Warriorz began their run with a 10-run loss to the Giants before going down by nine wickets versus RCB. On Wednesday (January 14) they suffered yet another loss to the Delhi Capitals. The clash versus MI is critical encounter for Warriorz to try and pull one their way and keep their tournament hopes alive. The Mumbai Indians Vs UP Warriorz WPL 2026 clash will be played in Navi Mumbai on Thursday, January 15. The match will start at 7:30 PM Indian Standard Time. The Mumbai Indians versus UP Warriorz match will be televised live in India on the Star Sports Network channels. The fixture will be available for live streaming on the Jio Hotstar app and website. The toss for the Mumbai Indians versus UP Warriorz WPL 2026 game will take place at 7:00 PM Indian Standard Time. Mumbai Indians: Harmanpreet Kaur (c), Nat Sciver-Brunt, Amelia Kerr, Hayley Matthews, Amanjot Kaur, Sajeevan Sajana, Shabnim Ismail, Gunalan Kullkarni, Nicola Carey, Sanskriti Gupta, Rahil Firdous, Poonam Khemnar, Triveni Vasistha, Nalla Reddy, Saika Ishaque, Milly Illingworth UP Warriorz: Meg Lanning (c), Deepti Sharma, Shikha Pandey, Phoebe Litchfield, Asha Sobhana, Sophie Ecclestone, Deandra Dottin, Kiran Navgire, Kranti Gaud, Shweta Sehrawat, Harleen Deol, Chloe Tryon, Suman Meena, Simran Shaikh, G Trisha, Pratika Rawal
